narr: Another atmospheric river pounded the Desert Southwest, bringing flooding and strong to severe thunderstorms to northwest Arizona.
ev: Highway 95 was closed near 7th Street, and multiple swift water rescues were needed.
Indian Head Drive was closed near the intersection of McCormick Boulevard due to flood damage.
Oatman Highway was damaged by flooding of the Warm Springs Wash.
